badge.name: Dart and Flutter Foundations
badge.description: Recognizes the named activity after instructor review at the confirmed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M4A4 (Monster Detail screen).

Award threshold: 75%.

m4a4: Monster Detail screen. Built a Flutter detail screen driven by a monster model. The assessment covered the name and type, current and maximum HP, a proportional health bar, phone layout, visual hierarchy and reusable widgets.
